versions.name: Pulp and Paper
versions.description: Pull your own sheet from wet pulp, follow fiber from managed forest to pulp mill to coated stock, compare mechanical and chemical pulping, and count the paper products filling an ordinary home.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
